info.title: MICROSERVICE-DocTest-List Parking Reservations Checkouts-v1-spec
info.description: The Parking Reservations Checkout API facilitates the retrieval of checkout details for previously made parking reservations. This endpoint allows users to access real-time information on their reservation checkouts, providing clarity on timeframes, locations, and vehicle specifics. Typical consumers of this API include parking service providers and mobile applications that assist users in managing their parking reservations efficiently. By leveraging this API, developers can enhance user experiences by integrating checkout information into their platforms seamlessly.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to complete the checkout process for a reservation, ensuring that all necessary information is processed and confirmed before finalizing the booking. It includes all relevant details required to manage payments and confirmation.

requestBody.description: Request body for initiating the checkout process for reservations. This body must contain the necessary reservation details, including the items being checked out and any user-specific information to complete the request.

200.description: The checkout request was successful and the reservation details are returned.

ListParkingReservationsCheckoutsRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the checkout operation in the reservations system. It is expected to be a plain string.

status.description: Indicates the success or failure of the operation.

referenceNumber.description: A unique identifier for the reservation reference.

resultId.description: An identifier for the result of the operation.

state.description: The current state of the reservation.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the request in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional details about the operation.

audit.description: Contains auditing information related to the operation.

ListParkingReservationsCheckoutsResponse.description: Response schema for the Checkout operation.

createdBy.description: The user or system that created the entry.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the entry was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the process was automated.

Audit.description: Auditing information related to the operation.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the time, in milliseconds, that the server took to process the request.
